edges.reason: owner() returns the stored _owner state variable.
onlyOwner compares owner() with _msgSender() (msg.sender) for authorization.
onlyOwner relies on the owner() view to determine the authorized account.

setMintPrice is gated by the onlyOwner modifier.

presaleMint applies the presaleOngoing modifier.
setStartingBlock gates recording on block.timestamp >= REVEAL_TIMESTAMP.
setStartingBlock compares against REVEAL_TIMESTAMP.
setStartingBlock compares the minted total against TOTAL_SUPPLY.
_mintPumpkins calls setStartingBlock after minting.
validSignature checks _usedCoupons to prevent coupon reuse.
validSignatureForFreeMint checks _usedCoupons to prevent coupon reuse.
freeMint is not gated by validSignature (uses free-mint variant) but shares flow via modifiers.
freeMint applies the validSignatureForFreeMint modifier.
presaleMint applies the validSignature modifier.
isValidSignature applies the validSignature modifier.
isValidFreeMintSignature applies the validSignatureForFreeMint modifier.
validSignature calls verifySignature with the coupon message hash.
validSignatureForFreeMint calls verifySignature with the address-bound hash.
verifySignature invokes ECDSA.tryRecover which executes ecrecover.
verifySignature consumes the hash produced by getMessageHash.
verifySignature consumes the hash produced by getMessageHashWithAddress.
verifySignature is called with owner() as the expected signer, so authorization depends on the owner state.
mint calls _mintPumpkins to perform the minting.
freeMint calls _mintPumpkins to perform the minting.
presaleMint calls _mintPumpkins to perform the minting.
giveaway calls _mintPumpkins to perform the minting.
_mintPumpkins calls _safeMint for each token.
_safeMint calls _mint internally.
_safeMint calls _checkOnERC721Received for contract recipients.

Transfers flow through the ERC721 receive-check path.
mint requires isMintActive to be true.

freeMint reads mintedPumpkins to compute mintedSoFar.

presaleMint reads mintedPumpkins to compute mintedSoFar.
presaleMint increments mintedPumpkins.

presaleMint uses GIVEAWAY_POOL as an offset on the minted count.
freeMint uses GIVEAWAY_POOL as an offset on the minted count.
giveaway enforces the GIVEAWAY_POOL cap.
giveaway reads givenAwayPumpkins for the cap check and mint offset.
giveaway increments givenAwayPumpkins.
mint enforces MAX_PER_PURCHASE.
mint enforces TOTAL_SUPPLY.
freeMint enforces TOTAL_SUPPLY.
presaleMint enforces TOTAL_SUPPLY.

tokenURI moduloes the shuffled id by TOTAL_SUPPLY.

presaleMint requires msg.value >= mintPrice.
tokenURI concatenates baseURI with the art id.
_baseURI returns the baseURI state variable.
setStartingIndex reads startingIndexBlock for blockhash randomness.
tokenURI uses startingIndex to shuffle metadata.
setStartingIndex writes the derived startingIndex.
withdraw performs an external transfer of the full balance to msg.sender.
msg.sender receives the contract balance, tying caller identity to the value transfer.
mint mints to _msgSender() (msg.sender).
freeMint mints to _msgSender() and binds the signature to it.
presaleMint mints to _msgSender().
isValidSignature uses the validSignature modifier as its validation path.
isValidFreeMintSignature uses the validSignatureForFreeMint modifier.
transferOwnership writes the new _owner.
renounceOwnership clears _owner to the zero address.
pumpkinsOfOwner stores the balance in a local array sized by balanceOf.
tokenURI computes the artId local variable.

_signature parameter exists only within freeMint() and should be merged into it.
_presalePass parameter exists only within presaleMint() and should be merged into it.
_signature parameter exists only within presaleMint() and should be merged into it.

_numTokens parameter is scoped to giveaway() and should be merged into it.

_provenance parameter is only written by setProvenanceHash() and should be merged into it.
_isMintActive parameter is only written by setIsMintActive() and should be merged into it.
_newURI parameter is only written by setBaseURI() and should be merged into it.
_mintedSoFar parameter is used only by _mintPumpkins() and should be merged into it.
